sloka: यदि माम् प्रतियुध्येरन् देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ।नैव सीताम् प्रदास्यामि सर्वलोकभयादपि ॥६-२४-३७॥।।
transliteration: yadi mām pratiyudhyeran devagandharvadānavāḥ ।naiva sītām pradāsyāmi sarvalokabhayādapi ॥6-24-37॥।।

translations.english: "Even if gods, Gandharvas and demons come to wage war with me, even if all the worlds threaten me, I shall not give away Sita."
